query:
SELECT u.id, u.email, u.role, d.id as dealer_id, d.company_name, d.subscription_status 
FROM users u 
LEFT JOIN dealers d ON u.id = d.user_id 
WHERE u.email = 'anthony.m.perry@gmail.com';
